answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 3750 Country: India Title: In Islam, is it allowed to celebrate birthdays. If anybody (Muslim or non muslim) invites a muslim to attend a birth day party, whether one should go to attend it or not? Question: In Islam, is it allowed to celebrate birthdays. If anybody (Muslim or non muslim) invites a muslim to attend a birth day party, whether one should go to attend it or not? Answer ID: 3750 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 34/34=M) It is unlawful to celebrate birthday, it is a tradition of the West and it has no importance in Islam. It is wrong to attend such nonsense celebrations whether the invitatory is a Muslim or a non-Muslim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
